title: My Peace I Give To You

request.style: English, female soft voice solo, piano, strings, acoustic guitar, synth pad, gentle and reassuring mood, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
I have told you these things while I am still with you
The word you hear is not mine but the Father's who sent me
If you do not love me you do not keep my words
But the Advocate the Holy Spirit is near

[Chorus]
Peace I leave with you my peace I give to you
I do not give to you as the world gives
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Do not be afraid in this moment

[Verse]
I am going away and I am coming back to you
If you loved me you would rejoice that I am going to the Father
The Father is greater than I
I have told you now before it happens

[Chorus]
Peace I leave with you my peace I give to you
I do not give to you as the world gives
Do not let your hearts be troubled
Do not be afraid in this moment

[Bridge]
So that when it does happen you will believe
The ruler of this world is coming
He has no claim on me

[Outro]
My peace I give to you
Do not be afraid
